title: A Griller started from the web board
summary: Spec v1: a Grill button on an inbox, backlog or ready item's panel; the board server runs the user's headless claude -p as board-griller, one run per message, this machine only, writes only that CR's folder; a waking board@1 grill line. Open: Q4 (user's), built on A; 2 more, built on A.
